findings.description: Directory API enumerated fully: pages 1-5 returned 10, 10, 10, 10 and 4 records (44 total, matching totalResults 44); page 6 returned no results, ending paging. All 44 brief people matched by name; no omissions found.
Owner determinations dated 2026-11-25 (Abd Arkadan, Tim Kane, Mehdi Abolhassani, Rohan Reddy Kalavakonda) are not in this brief and were not applied.

Profile pages were fetched for nine people with borderline entries (Chen, Dandekar, Shackleford, Johnson, Mancoridis, Lewin, Pourrezaei, Lui, Walsh). Other decisions rest on the directory entry and its title, type and department fields.

Chen, Zhiwei: regular/ece/current under the department-roster convention. Dual CEE and ECE listing with no primary-department statement elsewhere. Would change to joint_secondary only if the ECE roster designated him secondary.

Johnson, Jeremy: affiliate_professor/ece/current. CS professor listed under the ECE department as Affiliated Faculty. Would change to excluded only if the ECE affiliated listing were shown to be a generic lab membership.
Mancoridis, Spiros: affiliate_professor/ece/current on the same basis as Johnson.
Lewin, Peter: affiliate_professor/ece/current. Named professorship listed as Affiliated Faculty under ECE.
Pourrezaei, Kambiz: affiliate_professor/ece/current. Professor listed as Affiliated Faculty under ECE.
Dandekar, Kapil R.: regular/ece/current. Dean role does not drive the decision; the official profile states the ECE professorial chair.

Lui, Michael: excluded as adjunct. Directory title is blank, type Adjunct Faculty, and the profile shows no professorial title. Would change only if an official source showed a professorial ECE appointment.
Lambert, Kent: excluded as adjunct. Administrative title with Adjunct Faculty type; academic_professional would also exclude.
Madihian, Mohammad: excluded as adjunct despite the Adjunct Professor title, since adjunct is not a regular professorial appointment.
